6.description: [League 2] [AQT] [Twin Emperors] Emperor Vek'lors Shadow Bolt has been renamed to Bolt of Destruction.

[League 2] [AQT] [Twin Emperors] Emperor Vek'nilash's Unbalancing Strike will now reduce the targets Strength and Agility by a percentage amount rather then reducing the targets defence rating by 100 points. Tanks that have or exceed the defence rating requirement to be immune against critical strikes will no longer experience random critical hits from Emperor Vek'nilash.
[League 2] [AQT] [Twin Emperors] Emperor Vek'nilash's Unbalancing strike can no longer be avoided.

[League 2] [AQT] [Twin Emperors] Emperor Vek'nilash and Emperor Vek'lor will no longer cast The Emperor's Strength and The Emperor's Wit on their targets, instead they apply it to themselves, increasing their damage over time instead of increasing the damage their target takes.

[League 2] [AQT] [Twin Emperors] Emperor Vek'nilash and Emperor Vek'lor now have the same amount of health, this should reduce big jumps between their hp bars when the emperors update their health pool during combat.
[League 2] [AQT] [Princess Huhuran] Corrected an issue where Vekniss Martyr would appear a live after using their suicide ability.

[League 2] [AQT] [Princess Huhuran] Vekniss Martyr's Cloud of Death now stacks for each Martyr individually. If a player stands inside 3 clouds, he will now take damage from each cloud. Cloud of Death now deals 1% maximum health damage per tick.
[League 2] [AQT] [Princess Huhuran] Reduced the tick rate of the poison field left behind by Vekniss Martyr to 200 milliseconds down from 100 milliseconds.
[League 2] [AQT] [Princess Huhuran] Vekniss Martyr's Explosion will now deal Nature Damage instead of Shadow Damage.
[League 2] [AQT] [Princess Huhuran] Reduced the health of Veknis Martyr. Player should now have the option to kill them before they can reach their target.
[League 2] [AQT] [Princess Huhuran] Vekniss Protector now have a chance of 50%, down from 100% to reflect spells.

[League 2] [AQT] [Princess Huhuran] Kiss of the Princess will no longer target all enemies within 100 yards instead it will now target a single player and effect all targets within a range around the primary target. Kiss of the Princess can no longer be dispelled. Reduced the duration to 6 from 12 seconds.
[League 2] [AQT] [Princess Huhuran] Princess Huhuran's Wyvern sting ability has been renamed to Kiss of the Princess.
[League 2] [AQT] [Viscidus] Killing Viscidus Globs now causes him to lose mass.
[League 2] [AQT] [Viscidus] Poison Shock has been renamed to Acidic Spew and now has a more visible animation.
[League 2] [AQT] [Viscidus] Viscidus now requires 240 to 600 hits (depending on player count) to split.
[League 2] [AQT] [Viscidus] Increased the berserker timer of Viscidus to 10 minutes up from 6 minutes.
[League 2] [AQT] [Viscidus] Increased the health of Viscidus Globs across all difficulties.
[League 2] [AQT] [Viscidus] Viscidus Globs will now leave a trail of toxin behind when moving into the room centre.
[League 2] [AQT] [Viscidus] Reduced the movement speed of all Viscidus Globs across all difficulties. A glob that doesn't get slowed now requires approximately 20 seconds to reform into Viscidus.
[League 2] [AQT] [Fankriss the Unyielding] Corrected an issue where Fankriss the Unyielding could not stack his Mortal Wound debuff on his target.
[League 2] [AQT] [Battleguard Sartura] The Duration of Suspended Assault has been increased to 90 seconds up from 60 seconds.
[League 2] [AQT] [Battleguard Sartura] Summon dancing blade can no longer be interrupted and will no longer count towards Suspended Assault.
[League 2] [AQT] [Battleguard Sartura] Song of Oppression now reduces targets armor by 10% per stack and stacks up to 10 times. Previously would reduce armor by 2000 points and stack without limit.
[League 2] [AQT] [Battleguard Sartura] Song of the Colossus will now effect all player within 50 yards up from 20 yards. The damage has been reduced greatly.
[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] Corrected an issue where summoned creatures and objects would not despawn at the end of combat.
[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] Corrected a number issues where abilities could target pets.
[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] Corrected an issue where Vem's bleed debuff could generate to many stacks, causing the target to die instantly. Vem's bleed can now stack to a maximum of 100.
[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] Vem will no longer reset threat when he knock backs his target.
[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] Corrected an issue where Yauj's Dark Pillar would not apply fear to targets getting caught in it.

[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] Vem's on death ability "Enrage" has been renamed to "Vengeance". The damage increase and attack speed increase both Kri and Yauj get when Vem dies has been reduced from 102% to 50%.
[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] Yauj's on death ability "Brood of Yauj" now summons much more resistant creatures, it might be not worth the effort attempting to kill them.
[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] Lord Kri's on death ability "Poison Geyser" will now last until the end of combat.

[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family]  The Royal Bug Family will not award Mystic Orbs, Runes or Raiders Commendations because of technical limitations. C'thun will drop additional currency to compensate.
[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] All 3 member of the Royal Bug Family now have the same amount of health.
[League 2] [AQT] [Royal Bug Family] The Royal Bug Family now have their loot table combined. Player are able to obtain any item from any of the 3 bosses regardless of the order they get killed.
[League 2] [AQT] [Items] Added a Heroic version of the Eye of C'thun.
[League 2] [AQT] [General] Princess Huhuran will now exclusively drop set shoulders.
[League 2] [AQT] [General] Viscidus will now exclusively drop set boots.
[League 2] [AQT] [Items] All bosses within Ahn'Qiraji now have a chance to directly drop Blessed Weapons.
[League 2] [AQT] [Items] All profession recipes dropped within Ahn'Qiraji are now pooled and can drop from all bosses except C'thun. The drop chance for recipes has been increased.
[League 2] [AQT] [General] All boss encounter now have correctly working checkpoints.

7.description: Fixed an issue where One With the Light could make certain proc effects trigger twice from a single Crusader Strike or Divine Storm.

0.description: Corrected over 180 items having incorrect stats or pvp power when becoming bloodforged at level 60.

5.description: Grand Marshal's Warhammer and High Warlord's Battle Mace will now have 10 Haste Rating instead of 8 Mp5.
High Warlord's Tome of Mending and Grand Marshal's Tome of Restoration will now correctly increase damage and healing done by 6% and have an additional 10 Haste Rating.
High Warlord's Tome of Destruction and Grand Marshal's Tome of Power will now correctly increase damage and healing done by 6% and have an additional 14 Critical Strike Rating.
High Warlord's War Staff will now have 91 Spellpower and 28 Critical Strike Rating.
Grand Marshal's Stave Will now have 91 Spellpower and 28 Critical Strike Rating.
Fixed a left-over descrepancy where some Level 60 items still had the "bloody" tag instead of Bloodforged. These items had incorrect stats, pvp power and resillience.
Fixed an issue where some items had the incorrect PvP Power or Resillience Rating on the Arena Vendor.

0.description: Increased the minimum conquest cap on Gul'dan to 1200 from 800. (50% increase)
Fixed an issue where some people were able to remain on the in-game leaderboard after the pvp progression reset.
Implemented an experimental AI feature where your pet will now sometimes say interact with you via chat.a!changelog add fix live
Turn Evil is now usable on Gnomes.
Enslave Demon is now usable on players in Metamorphosis.
Tame Beast is no longer rollable on level 1.
Fixed a bug where Lockpicking had a lower than intended roll chance on Wildcard.
Fixed a bug where you could use talents and abilities from other classes.
Due to popular demand, the movement penalty from walking backwards (otherwise known as backpedaling) has now been removed.
Removed the gold cost from Fel Commutation and made all items Fel Commutated by default.
Fixed a bug where Presence of Mind did not reduce the cast time of Teleport and Portal spells.
Meating Deadlines now has an increased amount of meat dropped, increased by the number of available bag slots you have.
Fixed a bug where Mounts did not have their intended 3 second cast-time.
Non-gnome characters can now right-click any Gnome to pick them up and use them as a shield. While active, all physical damage you take will be redirected to the Gnome.
Gnomes can now right-click ally players to jump onto their shoulders. This also works with mounted players.
Reworked the You Like Jazz Mystic Enchant. It will now play Never Gonna Give You Up instead.
You can now be in multiple shapeshifts and gain the benefits from each shapeshift at the same time.
Titan's Grip no longer has damage penalties, but you can no longer use chest armor.
Due to popular demand from our tank players, Target Dummies will now hit back.
Debbie Downer now increases your own damage by 10%, but reduces the damage of your allies by 10%.
Reduced the damage your opponents take in PvP by 15%.
Increased the damage you take in PvP by 10%.
Added custom sound effects to fit the visuals of Titan Scrolls. (Those of you with sensitive hearing may want to turn your volume down to prevent injury.)
[New Rare Mystic Enchant] Taunting Feint - Increases the threat dealt by your Feint ability by 12%.
Fixed a bug where Life Tap would reduce current health instead of total health.
Fixed a bug where Bladestorm would break Invisibility.
Bladestorm will now reduce damage taken by 50% while active.
Divine Shield now makes you immune to the first 2000 damage you take while active. It no longer makes you immune to debuffs.
Eagle Eye has been reworked. It is now a shapeshift that turns you into an eagle for 20 seconds, letting you scout the battlefield before approaching.
fixed an issue where you could still roll The Right Smite (Deprecated) Mystic Enchantment

1.description: Fixed an issue with Hunger for Blood having a cooldown. [Requires launcher update]
Fixed an issue where Bloodthirst would not properly show its global cooldown when using it while Bloodsurge is active.

7.description: [New Legendary Enchant] Titanic Mutilate - While Titan's Grip is active you learn Mutilate (Titan), an attack with both weapons dealing 60% weapon damage, increased by 20% if your target is bleeding. Also, your Bloodthirst deals 5% more damage per active combo point and dealing damage with Whirlwind triggers Bloodrage (if known).

6.description: [League 2] [Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj] Drastically reduced some mechanic's damage numbers in the Ruins of Ahn Qiraj to prevent heavy front-loaded damage onto the raid.

[League 2] [Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj] General Rajaxx will now use his abilities approximately 35% slower. This will prevent an unlucky streak of RNG where the boss can do a knock-up into a knock-away & keep players far away from him.
[League 2] [MC] Increased the amount of Raiders Commendations awarded by looting Majordomo Executus Chest from 2 to 8.
[League 2] [BWL] [Chromaggus] Pending Restart: Chromaggus is now bound to his room and can no longer be moved outside.

0.description: Absorbs and healing over time effects had their effectiveness increased by 5% in arenas.

1.description: [League] Hammer of the Righteous now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 5%.
Added a visual to the Zephyr extra attack trigger.
[League] Lava Lash now deals 25% reduced damage against players, from 20%.
Holy Wrath now deals 5% reduced damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.

7.description: [League] Molten Earth now deals 10% reduced damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
Fixed an issue where the healing from Holy Nova (Holy Retribution) wasn't reduced.
The healing from Pious Strike Holy Nova has been reduced by 20%.
Fixed an issue where the Consecration effect from Purification by Light did not have its PvP mod applied.
The Throw Weapon stun now correctly has stun DR and will no longer knockdown the target. Its range has been reduced to 20 yards, from 30.
Fixed an issue where Weapon Command could be active while you had Titan's Grip.

0.description: Level appropriate arena water is now available from PvP accessory vendors.
